hypotheses.h12_cache_hit: The requested item is present in cached storage and the read is satisfied by the cached copy.
hypotheses.h12_cache_miss: The requested item is absent from the cache and must be fetched from the backing source.
hypotheses.h12_write_through: The cached update reaches durable backing storage before the write is acknowledged.
hypotheses.h12_write_back: The cached write is acknowledged before durable persistence, with the changed data written to backing storage later.
hypotheses.h12_semaphore: A limited number of permits controls concurrent access to a resource, and permits are returned when holders finish.

scope: External frozen cross-encoder, CPU only, safetensors, no remote custom code. All five original source cards must be retrieved by native Cortex and hash-verified. NLI premise is the scenario; hypothesis is the concept criterion. This estimates entailment, not proof of real-world truth. Compare lexical rank and NLI rank on identical candidates; gate overrides separately.
